articles.title: Russian daredevils stage proposal stunt atop the Empire State Building
articles.description: STORY: :: A Russian daredevil couple stages a marriage proposal stunt atop the Empire State Building :: New York // July 1, 2026 :: Angela Nikolau and Vanya Beerkus had earlier unfurled what appeared to be a peace banner :: Police later said they arrested the pair and expected to bring unspecified charges The pair, dressed in sleeveless black outfits, hung onto the landmark skyscraper's antenna spire near the glowing red light at its top some 1,454 feet (443 meters) above the sidewalk of midtown Manhattan. They held a black banner with a message in all-capital white letters that flapped in the wind: "When the power of love beats the love of power the world knows peace."
